title: Stability deep-dive prep — Michael Zhou
body:
Context / goal:
- Quick sync with report to align on current stability work, blockers, and concrete actions for the next two weeks. Not a status readout — focus on decisions and support I can provide.
- Primary outcomes I want: 1) clear mitigation plan for the latency regression, 2) ownership and timeline for the KV cache investigation, 3) agreement on what I will unblock as manager (people/time/infra).

Meeting structure (30 min):
- 0–3m: set intent (fast) — say: "I want this to be actionable; tell me what you need to get unblocked."
- 3–12m: stability deep-dive (root cause + hypothesis)
- 12–20m: mitigation and resourcing / who does what
- 20–27m: career/pressure check — how is this impacting capacity? any growth/coaching asks?
- 27–30m: confirm actions & next check-in date

Notes / data points to cover (bring these up if they don't):
- Observed: p95 latency for hosted generate endpoint up ~12% overall since 2026-04-01; tail spikes at 5–10s during bursts.
- Correlated w/ recent quantization rollout (canary deployed INF-4723) and kernel selection changes from release 2026.04.05.
- PR#884 rolled a micro-optimization to KV cache invalidation — suspected to increase cache churn for certain prompt shapes.
- SLO slack windows: we have a 250ms p95 target for dev-tier; currently dev-tier p95 ~280ms during peak.

Hypotheses to test (ask report):
1) Cache churn from PR#884 + new quantization path increases sequence-level recomputation for short prompts (low cost, high frequency)
2) Kernel selection fallback path triggers more often under bursty traffic, causing context-switch overhead
3) Autoscaler cooldown misconfiguration causes scheduling jitter when pools refresh after small bursts

Immediate mitigation options (discuss and decide):
- Roll back PR#884 from canary -> pros: quick; cons: loses other perf gains (ask tradeoffs).
- Temporarily pin model to previous kernel selection for high-traffic routes (needs infra/ops help).
- Short-term: increase dev-tier SLO allowance by 25% during investigation window (customer impact tradeoff) — requires approval from product ops.
- Run focused load test on quantized variant with KV trace enabled (need 4 GPU-hours + ops window).

What I can commit to as manager: (speak clearly)
- I can assign 1 additional engineer from the platform team for 3 days next week for instrumentation work.
- I will escalate to product ops about temporary SLO relaxation and email stakeholders with a brief summary if we decide to relax.
- I can book a 2-hour bug-bash session Friday afternoon and block calendar invites.

People / ownership suggestions (proposals to confirm in meeting):
- Lead investigation: report (confirm they accept) — 50% focus next 3 workdays
- Infra support contact: Samir Patel (observability + tracing) — unblock by EOD tomorrow
- PR owner for rollback/patch: Priya Nair — coordinate with release-engineering

Action items template (capture commitments live):
- [ ] Investigator: produce one-pager of top 3 repro cases and expected next steps (owner: REPORT, due: 2026-04-17)
- [ ] Infra: enable KV-level tracing on canary for 24h and share logs (owner: Samir, due: 2026-04-16)
- [ ] Release: prepare rollback plan and test on staging (owner: Priya, due: 2026-04-16)
- [ ] Manager: send stakeholder note with chosen mitigation and ETA (owner: Michael, due: 2026-04-16)
- [ ] Follow-up 1:1 slot to reconvene on results (owner: Michael + REPORT, date: 2026-04-18)

Career / coaching section (short):
- Check stress/capacity: "How heavy is this week on your focus? Do you need me to re-prioritize other asks?"
- Growth ask to raise: nudged toward being lead for a small stability initiative (visible cross-team). If report is interested, propose a 6-week project with defined success metrics (reduce p95 by X% or remove one failure mode).
- Feedback I want to give: call out their strong initiative on the KV cache telemetry earlier — say: "That initiative is why we have data to act on. Great job." Keep it specific.

Potential risks / escalation triggers (call these out so report and I can agree when to escalate):
- If p95 > 400ms consistently for >4h during business hours -> escalate to SRE lead and product ops.
- If root cause requires more than 7 engineer-days -> consider pausing other non-critical work and request temporary backfill.

Open questions to resolve in-meeting: 
- Does the team have capacity to run the KV-tracing load tests and analyze results by Fri? (yes/no)
- If we rollback, can we preserve the micro-optimization elsewhere or is it all-or-nothing? (ask Priya)

Tone / phrasing cheatsheet (quick bullets to use):
- When asking for status: "What evidence would convince you this is fixed?"
- When offering support: "If you want me to handle ops/comms, I will—tell me the audience and the one-sentence ask."
- When giving feedback: start with impact, then behavior, then next step: "Because X happened, Y impact. I noticed Z; next time try..."

Notes to self after meeting (placeholders):
- Capture exact repro steps they share and paste into INF-4723 comments.
- If they accept leading stability project, draft charter and success metrics before next 1:1.
- Follow up with Samir for tracing results and escalate if not available by deadline.

Scratch / random thoughts (keep short):
- Could we add a quick health-check to the canary pipeline to detect KV churn anomalies automatically? Low effort probe.
- Consider an async postmortem template focused only on regression vectors (kernel, quantize, release) to speed root cause capture.
- If promotion is on horizon, list 3 cross-team wins they can cite (telemetry, incident reduction, mentoring).

End.
